title: The Value of a Beard
summary: A courtier mocked Nasruddin's unkempt beard: "Mulla, what is your beard worth in gold?"...
full_text:
A courtier mocked Nasruddin's unkempt beard: "Mulla, what is your beard worth in gold?"

"It is worth nothing," smiled Nasruddin.

"Ha! Then my horse's tail is worth more than your beard!" laughed the courtier.

"Undoubtedly," replied Nasruddin serenely. "Your horse's tail can at least brush away flies; whereas your tongue cannot even brush away your own foolishness!"
moral: True honor does not reside in facial whiskers, but in the integrity of actions.
